units.source_text: 冷泉帝来到大原野，停了凤辇。

en.t: Emperor Reizei came to Oharano and halted the imperial carriage.

units.source_text: 诸亲王、公卿走入平顶的帐幕中去进餐，并脱下官袍，改穿常礼服或猎装。

en.t: The princes and court nobles went into the flat-roofed tent to dine, took off their official robes, and changed into informal court dress or hunting clothes.

units.source_text: 此时六条院主人进呈酒肴及果物来了。

en.t: At that time, the master of Rokujo-in sent in wine, delicacies, and fruit as offerings.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣今日本当随驾，冷泉帝亦早有示意，但因正值斋戒，未能奉旨。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, should have accompanied the imperial outing that day, and Emperor Reizei had already expressed such a wish, but because Genji was then observing ritual abstinence, he could not obey the command.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝收了进呈诸品，便令藏人左卫门尉为钦使，将穿在树枝上的一只雉鸡赐与源氏太政大臣。

en.t: After receiving the presented items, Emperor Reizei appointed the Kurodo Left Gate Lieutenant as imperial messenger and bestowed on Genji, the Grand Minister, a pheasant fastened to a tree branch.

units.source_text: 此时有何天语传达，为避免烦琐，恕不记述。

en.t: What imperial words were conveyed at this time will not be recorded here, in order to avoid needless detail.
